title: trond shadow-fork keygen output
description: Returned by `trond shadow-fork keygen -o json`. The shape depends on --out: without it the caller asked for the key on stdout and gets it, with it the key went to a 0600 file and only the address is echoed, so that a transcript or a log never carries the private key the caller deliberately wrote to disk.

private_key.description: The secp256k1 private key, 32 bytes hex. Present only when --out was NOT given. It signs blocks on the shadow-fork chain and nothing else, but it is a real key: do not persist it anywhere the fork's data directory is not already protected.

address.description: Base58Check address derived from the key. This is what goes into fork.conf as the witness address; java-tron will refuse to produce blocks if it disagrees with the key the node signs with.

hex_address.description: The same address in the 21-byte hex wire form (0x41 prefix + 20-byte body).

out.description: Path the shell exports were written to, present only when --out was given. The file is mode 0600 and holds SHADOW_FORK_WITNESS_KEY and SHADOW_FORK_WITNESS_ADDRESS.
